sql: SELECT SUM(trips) AS trips_completed_2025 FROM trips_daily WHERE service_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND service_date < DATE '2026-01-01';
notes: Assumes "completed trips" means the trips column in trips_daily summed over all boroughs and provider types for service dates in calendar 2025.

sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(ontime_pickups) / NULLIF(SUM(total_pickups), 0), 1) AS pickup_on_time_pct FROM pickup_otp_daily WHERE service_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND service_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
notes: Assumes on-time rate is total on-time pickups divided by total pickups across all providers, boroughs, and standards for calendar year 2025, with no weighting or filtering by standard.

sql:
WITH c AS (
  SELECT SUM(complaints) AS complaints
  FROM complaints_daily
  WHERE opened_date >= DATE '2024-01-01' AND opened_date < DATE '2025-01-01'
),
t AS (
  SELECT SUM(trips) AS trips
  FROM trips_daily
  WHERE service_date >= DATE '2024-01-01' AND service_date < DATE '2025-01-01'
)
SELECT
  c.complaints AS complaints_2024,
  t.trips AS trips_2024,
  ROUND(1000.0 * c.complaints / t.trips, 1) AS complaints_per_1000_trips
FROM c, t;
notes: Assumes complaints and trips are summed across all provider types, categories, and boroughs for calendar 2024, and that the two tables are compared as totals rather than joined row-by-row to avoid fan-out.

sql:
SELECT ROUND(AVG(no_shows_per_1000), 1) AS avg_no_shows_per_1000
FROM provider_no_shows_monthly
WHERE LOWER(provider_type) = 'primary'
  AND month >= DATE '2023-01-01'
  AND month < DATE '2024-01-01';
notes: Assumes the no-show rate is the simple average of the monthly no_shows_per_1000 values for 2023 (unweighted, since no trip counts exist in this table), with provider_type matched case-insensitively to 'Primary'.

sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(ride_time_min) * 1.0 / SUM(trips), 1) AS avg_ride_time_min FROM ride_time_monthly WHERE month >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND month < DATE '2026-01-01'
notes: Assumed ride_time_min is the total ride minutes per group (month, provider, peak hour, borough, on-time flag), so the 2025 average is total minutes divided by total trips, not an average of the row values.
